entities.summary: Adam Trevor Engel is an American former professional baseball outfielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Chicago White Sox and San Diego Padres. He was drafted by the White Sox in the 19th round of the 2013 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut with them in 2017.
